negative_reviews.author: Kelly Sunter
negative_reviews.text: This was my first time attending this restaurant in Metro Centre and it was very disappointing. For my daughter's birthday we decided to go here, she is obsessed with ramen noodles. Tried dishes she's had before in the UK and USA and it was very underwhelming or terrible as she describes it. It did not look nice. The broth and noodles were very hot while the egg, meat, and vegetables were cold. The ramen bowl was half filled. The broth was meant to be darker and it was pale, not dark enough for black garlic. My main meal dish didn't arrive and I had to chase the server as noone noticed. My daughter begged I did not tell them how awful her meal was.  The server on checking apologised and said i did not have to pay for my daughters meal owing to my meal not arriving and my daughter had finished her ramen bu then. The situation spolit our dining experience, we wanted to eat together.  We would never go back again and had to go elsewhere for lunch. Environment looked nice and chop sticks good quality.  It was too loud where we were sitting from the music to hear each other speak. Also the light did not have a shade on and situated middle of the table and far too bright. It triggered a headache. Awful dining experience. The server explained they dont know what happened to my order whether it got lost or simply the chef forgot. Worrisome considering it was not busy on arrival. I was really looking forward to trying here I would never recommend it to anyone.
